clips.label: Train into library
clips.note: Carriage windows → reading rooms; rails → paper
clips.details:
A 5⅔-second excerpt. Paper appears along the train before the carriage becomes library architecture. This continuation is included in the longer living-book film.

Krea Turbo recurrent feedback, CFG1, three Euler intervals. Time-based Lanczos warps. RIFE 4.25 scale 1, 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second. All paintings are preserved.

clips.label: Pull back from the clockwork world
clips.note: Reveal the sun — with reflected edge artifacts
clips.details:
Three-second extension of the clockwork film. A 30% shrink and small downward shift bring the sun into view. Reflected borders become repeated gears and ribbons; repainting does not convincingly replace them with a wider open scene. Preserve as a useful boundary test.

Krea Turbo recurrent feedback, CFG1, three Euler intervals. Time-based Lanczos warps. RIFE 4.25 scale 1, 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second. All paintings are preserved.
